newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DB Soft files for bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: German DB Soft files for bankruptcy.

text.p: German software firm DB-Soft AG Software said on Wednesday its chief executive Burkhard Stiller had applied to start bankruptcy proceedings for the firm, amid an acute shortage of liquidity.
DB-Soft said it was unable to survive under its own steam after its shareholders last Saturday turned down a proposal to sell the company.
However the firm was continuing to seek actively for a solution to its problems.
The head of DB-Soft's supervisory board, Wolfgang Scheer, resigned on Tuesday.
